snippet.title: Contractors Showdown: ExfilZone - Official Gameplay Trailer | Upload VR Showcase 2025
snippet.description: Watch the Gameplay Trailer for Contractors Showdown: ExfilZone, a VR multiplayer action shooter developed by Caveman Studio. Players can customize and fine tune a suite of weapons to take on tactical missions alone or with friends on a VR battlefield. Contractors Showdown: ExfilZone is available now for SteamVR and Meta Quest.
